# One Click One Block Legacy

---

## Description

**One Click One Block Legacy (1C1BL)** is an **unofficial backport** of [One Click One Block (1C1B)](https://modrinth.com/mod/oneclickoneblock) designed specifically for Minecraft Forge version 1.12.2.

## Features

- ✅ Adds a configurable short delay after the player destroys a block
- ⌨️ Provides a hotkey to toggle the functionality on/off
- ⚙️ Allows customization of the delay duration through configuration

## Credit

- Special thanks to [LucunJi](https://modrinth.com/user/LucunJi) for creating the original mod
